rows.name: FASTNET
rows.description: Circular white tower, 92 ft. high, with red belt, on the summit of the rock

rows.name: GALLEY HEAD
rows.description: White lt.-ho. on extr. of head. Lt. shows 6 or 7 flashes during 16 secs., and is obscured 44 secs. Visible between W. and E. by S.

rows.name: KINSALE OLD HEAD
rows.description: A white tower, 100 ft. high, with two red belts. A red ray is sent over the outer part of Courtmacsherry Bay, between N.W. by W. ½ W. to W. ¾ N., or from the Seven Heads to the Horse Rocks

rows.name: Kinsale Harbour
rows.description: From window on Fort Charles, on East side. From S.S.W. ½ W. to S.W. ½ S.

rows.name: Daunt's Rock Lt.-Ves.
rows.description: Vessel black, in 14 fms., at ¾ mile S. by E. from Daunt's Rock, and 4¾ miles S.W. from entrance to Cork Harbour. A fog-gun twice every ½ hour

rows.name: CORK HARBOUR — Poor Head
rows.description: At 3 miles S.E. of entrance to Cork, a fog-trumpet gives blast of 5 secs. every 2 min.

rows.name: CORK HARBOUR — Roche Point
rows.character: Upper lt. intermit. br. Lower light, fix. br.
rows.description: White tower, 49 ft. high. Upper lt. shows br. for 15 secs., and is eclipsed 5 secs. Lower br. lt. shows only from S.W. by W. to S.W. ½ S., over Daunt's Rk. Fog-bell twice in ev. min.

rows.name: CORK HARBOUR — Queenstown — SPIT BANK
rows.description: On piles, in 9 ft. water, on E. elbow of bank. Lt. red, with a sector of br. lt. over Bar Rock, between N.E. by E. ½ E. and N.E. ½ N.

rows.name: CORK HARBOUR — ME[?]LOUGH SPIT
rows.description: On piles, 100 ft. from the channel. Fog-bell...
A green lt. is shown on the N. side of the channel at Donkettle; a bright lt. at Black Rock Castle; and a red lt. at Dundain, and also at Tivoli

rows.name: BALLYCOTTIN
rows.description: Circular stone tower, 50 ft. high, on the outer island; shown from E. ½ N. to W. ½ N. Fog-bell

rows.name: Youghal
rows.character: 1. One bright fixed lt. 2. Lower red tide light 3. Additional red tide lt.
rows.description: 1. & 2. In one tower, on W. side of entrance 2. Shown from S.W. by S. to S. by W. ½ W. From 2h. before to 2h. after high water. A tide-ball by day 3. Shown from small building E. of lightho., betw. S.S.E. ½ E. & S.E., from 2h. before to 1½h. after high water

rows.name: MINEHEAD
rows.description: On S. side of head. Bright, 50 secs.; suddenly dark, 10 secs. Shown from W. by S. ½ S. to E. ¾ N.

rows.name: Dungarvan
rows.description: On Ballinacourty Pt. Red over Carrickapane Rock; green, over rocks from Ballinacourty Pt., from E. to S.E. by E.; and bright in other directions

rows.name: WATERFORD — HOOK TOWER
rows.description: Tower, 115 ft. high, striped red and white horizontally, on E. side of entrance. Fog-gun every 10 min.

rows.name: WATERFORD — Dunmore, Pier Head
rows.description: West side of entrance. It is bright N. of pier

rows.name: WATERFORD — Duncannon Fort
rows.description: In one tower. The lower is only seen seaward

rows.name: WATERFORD — Duncannon N.
rows.description: Half a mile N.N.E. ¾ E. of the fort. In one, with fort lights, lead in

rows.name: WATERFORD — Spit of Passage
rows.description: One fixed red light, on piles

rows.name: WATERFORD — Rosslare
rows.description: Ballygerry Bay, Wexford. Bright light on breakwater in progress
